_comment: Curated macro / market context for the AI Analysis (the context register).
This file is OPTIONAL and unlike every other config it degrades
silently: when it is absent the analysis simply runs without macro
context. It is the only channel through which anything time-sensitive
reaches the model on an air-gapped deployment -- the model's own
knowledge is frozen at its training cutoff and is never allowed to
supply current conditions.
Rules for maintainers (this file is under the same MRM change control
as the prompts in aecb/brief/prompts/):
- every entry must hold true AS OF the as_of date below; update
as_of whenever entries are reviewed, even if unchanged
- entries are short, factual and generic -- no issuer-specific or
customer-specific content, no forecasts
- the analysis renders these as background context with the as_of date
attached; they never carry severity and never cite the payload
`owner` and `review_cadence` name who keeps this file current and how
often; `sectors` is the closed vocabulary the AI Analysis's risk block
may use when it INFERS an employer's sector from the employer name
(always labelled 'inferred, verify'); `register`
entries are dated, topic-tagged context (sectors under stress, rate
direction, regulatory caps, salary-flow risks) and join the background
facts -- the only channel. The model's own macro knowledge stays
forbidden.

register.text: Sectors whose income is project-cyclical or demand-sensitive carry more salary-interruption risk than salaried government or banking employment; construction and contracting, hospitality and tourism and retail trade are the sectors to read with that caution.

Retail lending is predominantly variable-rate priced off EIBOR; a borrower with long-tenor variable-rate exposure carries payment-shock risk if rates move up, and relief if they move down. No forecast is made here.

Central Bank of the UAE retail rules cap the debt burden ratio at 50% of gross salary, personal loans at 20 times salary with a 48-month tenor, and auto loans at 80% of the vehicle value; facilities granted near these ceilings leave little absorption room.

Salary-transfer repayment is deducted at source, so a delay on a salary-transfer facility is consistent with the salary stopping or moving; an employer change or a termination near such a delay is the first thing to verify.
